content: No, that is not true. In Switzerland, voter registration is typically handled at the municipal level, as Switzerland has a federal system with strong cantonal (state) and municipal autonomy. However, once you are registered with your local municipality, you are automatically registered for federal elections and votes as well. There is no need to separately register with the federal government. Voter registration is usually done automatically when you are assigned a residence by the municipality, or you can register voluntarily at any time before an election.
